instruction: Apply a fade transition effect to the slide in this presentation and save it.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully exported the Impress presentation to PNG by navigating File > Export, selecting PNG format, renaming to res.png, and accepting default PNG options.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Impress menus, use file dialogs, change file format dropdowns, rename files, accept dialog defaults
metadata.task_rationale: Agent demonstrated ability to navigate Impress UI. This variation tests using the Slide menu or Slide Transition panel to apply a transition effect, testing a different UI interaction pattern.
metadata.explanation: Task requires applying a fade transition to the first slide. Evaluator uses existing check_transition metric which parses the slide XML to verify a <p:fade> transition element exists. Postconfig saves the file before evaluation.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vm_file) correctly downloads the saved pptx from the VM after postconfig triggers Ctrl+S to ensure file is saved
Metric (check_transition) correctly parses slide XML from the pptx zip to find <p:fade> transition element on slide 0
Expected parameter handling is correct: with type='rule', the rules dict is passed directly and accessed as rules['slide_idx'] and rules['transition_type']
Full instruction coverage: fade transition check covers the 'apply fade transition' requirement, and postconfig Ctrl+S covers the 'save it' requirement
Transition type 'fade' correctly maps to <p:fade/> in OOXML format used by LibreOffice Impress
